items.lede: Sony is launching a new AI upscaling technology specifically for the regular PS5. The new tech, called Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), is a "new performance tier of AI upscaling" that's a result of Sony's Project Amethyst work with AMD, according to a blog post. items.lede: Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei are the first games to support Quick Spectral Super Resolution.
items.title: Sony brings AI upscaling to the base PS5

items.lede: The base PS5 is getting an optimized version of Sony's AI-powered upscaling technology, offering developers a new way to improve image quality and stability without demanding more powerful hardware.
